description: Applies to the one window. A window outside this list gets NO permissions at all, not reduced ones — a second window briefly existed here and had to be listed by pattern for its `invoke` calls to work at all. Minimal surface. The frontend gets NO filesystem, shell, or http permission. Every privileged action goes through a named, validated #[tauri::command] in src/ipc.rs, which is the only place path validation lives.
